error[ZBX-E0562]: service account key files are not supported
  cause  /home/ci/gcp.json is a service account key file; zbx does not use key
         files
  var    GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  fix    use workload identity federation: an external_account file, with no key
         then delete the key: anyone who has it is the service account
  more   zbx explain E0562
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0562.html
